title: Bio:Renew Argan Oil of Morocco Shampoo

details.description: Indulge in the luxurious experience of our Argan Oil of Morocco Shampoo, crafted with the finest natural-origin ingredients endorsed by the prestigious Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew. This transformative formula is designed to smooth and repair your hair from root to tip, leaving it beautifully nourished and revitalised. Infused with a captivating scent that features multilayered notes of fizzy citrus, exotic spices, and creamy vanilla, this shampoo will leave your hair smelling fresh and invigorated throughout the day. Whether you have dry, damaged, or frizzy hair, this paraben-free and colourant-free formula provides intense hydration and repair to help restore your hair's natural beauty and silky smoothness. Elevate your haircare routine with the power of Argan Oil of Morocco Shampoo and experience the difference in your hair's health and radiance.
details.usageInstructions:
Shake before use
Apply on wet hair
Lather and rinse

details.description: Indulge your senses with Herbal Essences bio: renew Coconut Milk Shampoo, a luxurious haircare experience that hydrates and revitalises your locks. Crafted with care and expertise, this shampoo offers a multi-layered scent journey, starting with the vibrant aroma of coconut, followed by a fresh bouquet of white florals and a deep, comforting vanilla. Infused with bio: renew, a signature blend of essential antioxidants, aloe, and sea kelp, this shampoo works to repair damage and leave your hair shining brighter and more hydrated in just 21 days. Coconut milk, renowned for its moisturising and conditioning benefits, penetrates deep into the hair shaft to replenish moisture and restore vitality to dry, damaged tresses. Free from parabens, gluten, and colourants, this shampoo provides a sensorial experience that leaves your hair feeling soft, smooth, and irresistibly fragrant. Immerse yourself in the luxurious lather and let Herbal Essences bio: renew Coconut Milk Shampoo transform your hair into a manageable, damage-resistant masterpiece.

1. Apply Shampoo generously to wet hair, massage into a creamy lather and then rinse.
2. Follow with Herbal Essences' conditioner with bio-renew.
